coherent model Continually test whether programme activities are producing the intended outcomes, and simplify, refine and strengthen over time Supporting staff practice Line-manage the Community consistency and confidence in their work through shadowing, guidance and external training Shaping resident progression Oversee how residents move through Mazí, from arrival to transition, identifying emerging patterns across individuals and houses, synthesising the housing and casework perspectives Hold key decisions and coordinate responses around engagement, extensions and move-on readiness Deep knowledge of cellular network planning and operations, including distributed antenna systems, small cells, and 5G network slicing.
